info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Current Account Management API
info.description: The Current Account Management API allows authorized users to update specific details of current accounts, facilitating smooth account maintenance. This endpoint is primarily used by financial institutions and banking applications to modify customer account information as needed. Typical consumers include bank customer service representatives and system administrators when handling updates for account features or customer requests. This API enhances operational efficiency and customer satisfaction by streamlining account management processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a current account in the deposit lending system. It supports partial updates to various fields of the account.

requestBody.description: This request allows the client to update specific details of the current account identified by ACC-200045. Ensure that all necessary fields are included in the request body to accurately reflect the desired changes.

200.description: The request was successful and the current account details have been updated.
